24.03.2023 SPA No. 65 of 2023
Sri Vipin Sanghi, C.J.
Sri Alok Kumar Verma, J.
Ms. Priyanka Agarwal, learned counsel for the 
appellant.
Issue notice.
Ms. Charanjeet Kaur, learned counsel appears and 
accepts notice on behalf of respondent no. 1. 
Let notice issue to respondent no. 2, returnable on 
16.08.2023, by all permitted modes, including 
electronically. 
All the parties shall file their respective written 
submissions on the question of law, which arises for 
consideration, namely, whether the appellant can claim 
interest for the period, from when the possession of land 
was taken (which is after the date of the award) till the 
date of actual payment, in proceedings under Section 
3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956, or such a relief 
can be sought in proceedings under Article 226 of the 
Constitution of India, since the remedy under Section 
3G(5) is not available for claiming interest for the 
aforesaid period. 
The written submissions be filed, along with the 
relevant case law(s) within four weeks. 
List on 16.08.2023.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) (Vipin Sanghi, C.J.)
 24.03.2023 24.03.2023
Rahul

20.03.2024 SPA No. 65 of 2023
Hon’ble Ritu Bahri, C.J.
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Ms. Priyanka Agrawal, learned 
counsel for the appellant/writ petitioner.
2. Ms. Rajni Supyal, learned Brief 
Holder for the State.
3. Mr. Raunak Pant, learned counsel, 
holding brief of Mr. Naresh Pant, learned 
counsel for the respondent.
4. In the present case, initially the 
award was given on 12.05.2015 and the 
petitioner was given the entire payment within 
time. Subsequently, a supplementary award 
came on 10.01.2017 and this payment of Rs. 
2.27 Crore was given on 20.07.2020.
5. Counsel for the petitioner further 
states that the interest on the supplementary 
award has been given from 2015 till 2017.
6. In the present case, counsel for the 
writ petitioner is seeking benefit of interest 
from 2017 to 2020.
7. At this stage, counsel for the 
respondent seeks a short adjournment to 
inform as to how many cases have been 
referred for arbitration with respect to this very 
acquisition proceeding.
8. List on 29.04.2024.
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) (Ritu Bahri, C.J.) 20.03.2024
